name: Media
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of guarding what we set before our eyes, as seen in Psalms 101:3, which warns against allowing wickedness to influence us. The eye is described as the light of the body (Matthew 6:22; Luke 11:34), highlighting how a focused and pure perspective fills us with light, whereas an evil eye brings darkness. In the context of media, this calls believers to discernment and vigilance against harmful content, including violence, as suggested by the need to remove anything that causes offense (Mark 9:43). Furthermore, Isaiah 52:7 celebrates the proclamation of good news and peace, underscoring the positive role that truthful and uplifting communication should play in our lives.
